resources.string: Pin the app in the recents screen to prevent system from closing it in the background.

Pen Mouse S requires its accessibility service to be enabled for proper functionality.

Accessibility services are needed to:

- Display the cursor above other apps, including the notification panel and the lock screen
- Simulate touch input on the screen, mirroring S Pen movements

Pen Mouse S does not read your screen content.
Remember to REMOVE the S Pen from the phone and WAIT for a successful connection BEFORE turning on Air Mouse.
